prompts.prompt: In a self-hosted Sublime Security deployment, which two data stores handle message metadata storage and full-text search, respectively? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sublime/SKILL.md - Self-Hosted Option components list: PostgreSQL for message metadata storage, Elasticsearch for full-text search.

prompts.prompt: In Sublime Security MQL rules, what string function computes character-level similarity between a sender domain and a protected organization domain, commonly used to catch lookalike domains? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sublime/SKILL.md - MQL Examples, Lookalike domain detection: strings.edit_distance(sender.email.domain, example.com) in [1, 2].

prompts.prompt: In Sublime Security's YAML rule schema, which rule type value defines a reusable boolean condition that other rules can reference, as opposed to the standard detection rule type. Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sublime/SKILL.md - Rule Types section: type signal is a boolean signal that can be referenced in other rules for composability.
